_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: The header, feature and first-token tests under completion prompting, on the base-adapted pair, run side by side on separate accelerators. Row completion is not repeated: it is already measured at these query counts in this mode on both models, and repeat runs returned identical counts, so the probe files carry it. Projected 4.3 h per model, both at once. Every cell is written to the results file as it finishes and --resume continues an interrupted session.

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: base model; header, feature and first token; ~4h20m
